status: proposed; not an implemented API or a second authority
decision: Use the existing record/getter field names below for the plan's new public representations. No new CLI flags or lifecycle meanings are proposed.

NativeHookSpec.evidence: References to checked parser/fixture/contact documents; never a live activation claim
NativeHookSpec.pi: Include extension_entrypoint=pi/index.ts and describe extension events; no settings-file recipe

PaneScope.meaning: launch_id and optional binding_id are expectations; a changed occupant is reported, never followed

PaneFacts.lifecycle: Reuse existing Lua availability, coverage, observations, requests, retention_floors, diagnostics, snapshot_id and badge_acknowledgement names; exclude cached from headless availability

HookDelivery.target: Existing binding target with binding_id; not a controller grant
HookDelivery.text: Present exactly when availability is available; excluded from diagnostics and stored facts
HookDelivery.exit_code: Present only when the started child supplies an exit code

ViewChange.target: Existing launch or binding target; independent from GUI-local window_id

tradeoff: These explicit layouts add public field names that consumers will rely on. Reusing current names reduces translation; separate availability and effect fields preserve distinct meanings.
held_actions: Pinning and implementing these public serialized layouts in U1-U5; U7's already specified layout and internal metadata work remain independent
